scene.ko: 난파선 유물 전시에서 해설을 알아듣고 더 깊이 질문한 뒤, 사진 촬영이 안 되는 구역에서 촬영 규칙을 확인한다.

lines.en: These items are from the Silver Gull, a trading ship that sank about four hundred years ago.
lines.ko: 이 유물들은 약 400년 전에 가라앉은 무역선 «실버 걸»호에서 나온 거예요.

lines.en: How did they manage to bring all of this up from the bottom of the sea?
lines.ko: 바다 밑바닥에서 이걸 다 어떻게 끌어올렸어요?
alt: How were they able to get all this up from the seabed?
How did they bring all these things up from the sea floor?

lines.en: Divers worked on it for almost ten years. Many items survived because they were buried in sand.
lines.ko: 잠수부들이 거의 10년 동안 작업했어요. 모래에 묻혀 있어서 남아 있는 유물이 많아요.

lines.en: That's incredible. Sorry, did you say the sand protected them? I thought salt water would ruin everything.
lines.ko: 대단하네요. 죄송한데, 모래가 지켜 줬다고 하셨어요? 바닷물 때문에 다 망가졌을 줄 알았어요.
alt: Amazing. Sorry, the sand protected them? I thought the salt water would destroy everything.

lines.en: Good point. The sand kept the air out, so the wood and cloth didn't rot as quickly.
lines.ko: 좋은 지적이에요. 모래가 공기를 막아서 나무와 천이 그렇게 빨리 썩지 않았어요.

lines.en: That makes sense. Would it be all right if I took a few pictures of these coins?
lines.ko: 이해가 되네요. 이 동전들 사진을 몇 장 찍어도 괜찮을까요?
alt: I see. Is it okay to take some pictures of these coins?
Got it. May I take a few photos of the coins?

lines.en: I'm afraid photography isn't allowed in this section. Some of these items are on loan from another museum.
lines.ko: 죄송하지만 이 구역에서는 사진 촬영이 안 돼요. 일부 유물은 다른 박물관에서 빌려 온 거라서요.

lines.en: Oh, I didn't see a sign. Sorry about that. Is it okay in the rest of the museum?
lines.ko: 아, 표지판을 못 봤어요. 죄송해요. 박물관 다른 곳에서는 괜찮나요?
alt: Oh, sorry, I missed the sign. Can I take photos in other areas?
Sorry, I didn't notice. What about the rest of the museum?

lines.en: Yes, as long as you don't use flash. You can also find high-quality images of these coins on our website.
lines.ko: 네, 플래시만 안 쓰시면 돼요. 이 동전들의 고화질 사진은 저희 웹사이트에서도 보실 수 있어요.

lines.en: Perfect. I'll look them up later. Thanks for being so understanding.
lines.ko: 잘됐네요. 나중에 찾아볼게요. 너그럽게 이해해 주셔서 고마워요.
alt: Great. I'll check the website later. Thanks for understanding.
Okay, I'll look them up later. Thank you for being so patient.

expressions.note: 잘못 들었을까 봐 다시 확인할 때

expressions.en: Would it be all right if I ___?
